annotations.title: EVM calldata decoder with pre-signing risk flags

description: Decodes EVM calldata before signing: function signature, selector, named arguments, candidate signatures for ambiguous selectors, one level of bundled calls (multicall, Multicall3, ERC-4337 execute, Safe execTransaction, multiSend), token symbol and decimals, and risk flags with reasons for unlimited approvals, setApprovalForAll, permits, transferFrom, admin calls and delegatecall. Sources: Sourcify ABIs and 4byte signatures, JSON-RPC via PublicNode. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

chain.description: Chain of the transaction by name or id: base (8453), ethereum (1), arbitrum (42161), optimism (10), polygon (137), avalanche (43114). Default base when to is given.

data.description: Transaction calldata, 0x-prefixed hex with a 4-byte selector; at most 16,384 hex digits (8 KB).

to.description: Contract the transaction is sent to. When given, its Sourcify-verified ABI (following a proxy to its implementation) decodes the call, and token symbol, decimals and contract-code checks are added.

name: chain_calldata_decode
